_comment: Owner-supplied v2 identities. 20.10.2026: deployer and operator generated locally (keys in ~/.predge-deployer-v2/, 0600, never committed), nonce 0 on Arc and Base at creation; owner stays null until the Safe exists. `deployer` = a NEW key created by the owner (pays gas only, holds no role, nonce 0 on every chain). `owner` = the Safe multisig (on EVERY chain you deploy to, at the same address if you want the same wiring everywhere). `operator` = the hot ops key (rotatable by the owner). dry-run and --broadcast refuse to run while any of these is null. --fork ignores this file and uses throwaway anvil accounts.
